blocks.text: Sensory neurons impulses ko receptors se central nervous system tak le jate hain. Un ki cell bodies CNS ke bahar guchhon (clusters) mein hoti hain jinhein ganglia kehte hain. Un ki cell body se ek taraf dendrite aur doosri taraf axon nikalta hai. Sensory neurons unipolar hain, yaani un mein sirf ek lamba dendrite hota hai. Dendrite ke aakhri sire par bohat si chhoti shakhein hoti hain jo receptors se judi hoti hain.

Motor neurons impulses ko central nervous system se door (effectors ki taraf) le jate hain. In mein ek sire par cell body, ek lamba axon aur bohat se dendrites hote hain. Un ki cell bodies CNS ke andar hoti hain. Yeh multipolar hain, yaani in ke bohat se dendrites hote hain jo aage bohat si chhoti shakhon mein batt jate hain. In ke dendrites dimagh aur spinal cord ke doosre neurons se milte hain.

Inter-neurons (associative neurons) poore ke poore CNS ke andar hote hain. Yeh sensory neurons ya doosre inter-neurons se impulses lete hain aur motor neurons ya doosre inter-neurons ko bhejte hain. Kuch inter-neurons ke axons chhote hote hain; yeh qareeb ke neurons ke saath circuits bana kar thori maloomat ka tajziya (analyse) karte hain. Kuch inter-neurons ke axons lambe hote hain; yeh dimagh aur spinal cord ke mukhtalif hisson ke inter-neurons se judte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen neurons ka aik raasta: baayen receptor ke siron wala sensory neuron, jis ki cell body aik side shakh par hai, impulse inter-neuron ko deta hai, jo motor neuron ko deta hai, aur motor neuron ka myelinated axon effector par khatam hota hai. Chhote teer impulse ki simt receptor se effector tak dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ke saath chalein: receptor se paigham sensory neuron mein aata hai, sensory neuron use inter-neuron ko deta hai, inter-neuron motor neuron ko, aur motor neuron effector (muscle ya gland) tak pohanchata hai. Teen neurons ki yeh zanjeer hi har paigham ka bunyadi raasta hai.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab sensory neurons ko 'sirf ek lambe dendrite' wala unipolar kehti hai. Zyada tar sensory neurons ko pseudo-unipolar kehna behtar hai: cell body se ek hi shakh nikal kar do mein batt jati hai, ek receptor se aane wali lambi shakh aur ek CNS mein jane wali shakh.

blocks.prompt: Sensory aur motor neurons ki cell bodies kahan hoti hain?
blocks.explanation: Sensory neurons: CNS ke bahar ganglia mein (jaise dorsal root ganglia). Motor neurons: CNS ke andar.

items: Sensory neuron: receptor se CNS, cell body ganglia mein, unipolar. Motor neuron: CNS se effector, cell body CNS mein, multipolar. Inter-neuron: poora CNS ke andar, chhote ya lambe axons.
